scope: reused development; no SOTA or confirmation claim

definitions.recall: equal-case mean of per-run eligible category-event Recall@5
definitions.gate: minimum case Recall>=.90; researcher-defined, not conference standard
definitions.selected: per-case attackers chosen separately for Hit and MAE on validation only
definitions.envelope: per-case best attack within tested bank, then case mean; exploratory only
definitions.bytes: JSON ID lists, all six categories per event; not actual network bytes
definitions.timing: separate 36-run serial local-host profile, three validation records
definitions.frontier: within each B only; exploratory finite-grid non-dominance; no statistical superiority
